about_the_game:
Animal Bakery: Prologue

Welcome to the limited-time Prologue（Demo)of Animal Bakery! Get a taste of the management and storytelling in this charming simulator.

Wishlist the full game now to be the first to know when you can expand your bakery to its fullest potential!，or join the discord for news: 

During your soft opening, you can experience:

3 languages supported: English, Chinese, Japanese.

All the Management Tasks You Love – And More!

Jump into the life of a bakery manager! Recruit and train a quirky staff, research delicious new recipes, expand your store, run strategic advertisements, upgrade your baking equipment, stock your shelves with a variety of fresh pastries, and decorate your space with style. Your ultimate goal? To give every customer an unforgettable experience.

Full experience of Chapter 1: My Life as an Undercover Bakery Manager

You were recruited by a local gang to set up a front for a money-laundering operation... but you have a different plan. As an ambitious manager, you see the real potential for this bakery to become a beloved neighborhood staple. Explore the town after hours: talk to neighbors and customers, help them with their problems, and unlock their heartfelt stories. You might just find yourself growing attached to the community—and falling in love with your charming little bakery.

Meet 4 Special Customers & 4 Unique NPCs

Attract elusive visitors like a grumpy but hilarious old bird or a pack of adorable, soulful puppies. These special customers are hard to please! Discover their individual preferences and win them over with the right advertisements, the perfect pastry, or a decoration they can’t resist. When you do, they’ll reward you with uniquely delightful reactions! You will be able to chat with them and unlock 1/4 of their stories. 

What to Expect in the Full Game(Not included in the Demo):

  • Deeper Stories: Unlock the full narratives of 10+ unique characters.

  • A Complete Undercover Journey: Experience 5 more chapters full of laughter, tears, and unexpected twists.

  • Expanded Management Gameplay:

    • Collect special bakery tools to unlock secret recipes.

    • Send letters to renowned bakery curators to level up your recipes.

    • Organize seasonal festivals with different themes.

    • Launch creative marketing campaigns to attract rare and special customers.

Wishlist & Follow now to support us!

short_description: It is a DEMO of Animal Bakery. Managing a bakery as an undercover for a local animal gang isn't easy. Hire staff, research new recipes, expand the store, and attract special customers. But you might wonder: Which is the better life? Running a successful bakery or letting the thug life choose you?
